title: Barclays CEO on Bonds, AI, UK Taxing Banks
description:
Barclays Plc Chief Executive Officer CS Venkatakrishnan discusses why the bond market is under pressure, how the bank is using artificial intelligence and he called on the UK government to not raise taxes on banks in the next budget. He speaks to Bloomberg's Dani Burger
